description: Move stock between locations — bin to bin inside a warehouse, or straight into another managed warehouse — the Inventory page's Move action. Only available (unreserved) units move. Each line names the item, quantity, source location (optional when the item is in one location) and destination location (defaults to the item's default location in the destination warehouse). The preview shows stock at both ends before and after. Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt. For a tracked in-transit shipment between warehouses use create_transfer_order instead. Max 100 lines per call.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants. Client-pinned credentials omit this.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

lines.description: Move lines (max 100). All lines commit together or not at all.

fromLocation.description: Source location name, code, barcode or id. Optional when the item sits in exactly one location of the source warehouse.

serials.description: Serial numbers, for serial-tracked items (one per unit).

toLocation.description: Destination location name, code, barcode or id. Optional: defaults to the item's default location in the destination warehouse.

toWarehouseId.description: Destination warehouse id (GUID). Optional: defaults to the source warehouse (a bin-to-bin move).

upc.description: Item UPC/barcode, used when SKU is absent or unmatched.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.

warehouseId.description: Source Internal warehouse id (GUID). May be omitted when the tenant has exactly one Internal warehouse.

name: move_stock
title: Move Stock
